text:
The guy sat next to me on the train pulled out a photo of his wife and said, “She’s beautiful, isn’t she?” I said, “If you think she’s beautiful, you should see my girlfriend mate.”
He said, “Why? Is she a stunner?” I said, “No, she’s an optician.”
gist: Stranger on a train boasts his wife is beautiful; the man says he should go see his girlfriend, who turns out to be an optician, implying the stranger needs his eyes checked.

wordplay.explanation: 'You should see my girlfriend' sounds like a boast about her looks but means 'go visit her professionally' since she is an optician.

characters.looks: man in casual jacket, deadpan face
proud man, holding wallet photo, beaming smile
plain-looking woman in a small photo
woman in white coat, glasses, eye chart behind

adaptNote: phrase as 'you should go to my girlfriend' (сходить к моей девушке), works with окулист

text:
Sex with the priest's wife
Jack goes to his buddy Bob and says ...
"I'm sleeping with the priest's wife. Can you hold him in church for an hour after mass for me?"
The friend doesn't like it but being a buddy, he agrees.
After mass, Bob starts talking to the priest, asking him all sorts of stupid questions, just to keep him occupied.
Finally the priest gets annoyed and asks him what he's really up to.
Bob feeling guilty, finally confesses to the priest...
"My friend is sleeping with your wife right now, so he asked me to keep you occupied."
The priest smiles, puts a brotherly hand on Bob's shoulder and says...
"You better hurry home now. My wife died a year ago".
gist: Man stalls a priest so his friend can sleep with the priest's wife, confesses, and learns the priest is a widower, so the friend is with the confessor's own wife.

characters.looks: sly man, leather jacket, sneaky grin
awkward man, Sunday shirt, guilty sweaty face
calm older priest, black cassock, white collar, kind smile
woman at home, robe, opening the door

adaptNote: Orthodox priest with a wife fits naturally

You can’t imagine the happiness I felt as I saw him put his pistol back in his pocket.
gist: Man describes generously giving his valuables to a poor stranger and his joy at the end, which reveals he was being robbed at gunpoint.

text:
Genie: You have 3 wishes.
Me: I've seen this before. Whatever I wish for will come back and bite me in some way.
Genie: I promise that won't happen. I'm so sure it won't I'll give you infinite wishes if it does.
Me: Okay. I wish for a boomerang with teeth.
Genie: You son of a ........
gist: Genie promises infinite wishes if a wish backfires, and the man traps him by wishing for a toothed boomerang that bites by design.

characters.looks: blue genie, smoke tail, golden bracelets, confident grin
skeptical man, t-shirt, holding old lamp

text:
Do you ever wake up, kiss the person sleeping beside you, and be glad that you are alive?
I did and apparently will not be allowed on this airline again...
gist: Heartwarming routine of kissing the person sleeping beside you turns out to be done to a stranger on a plane, getting him banned.

text:
When I was a kid, my parents would always say "Excuse my french" after a swear word...
...I'll never forget that first day at school when the teacher asked did we know any french.
gist: Parents always apologize for swearing as 'French', so when the teacher asks the class if anyone knows French, the child proudly recites curse words.

wordplay.explanation: The idiom 'excuse my French' makes the child think swear words are the French language.

characters.looks: small eager schoolboy raising hand, backpack
middle-aged woman teacher, glasses, cardigan
tired dad swearing at home
mom covering her mouth after swearing

adaptNote: Russian has the same calque 'извините за мой французский'.

text:
My wife is pregnant and my doctor asked me if I had ever been present at a childbirth before.
I replied, "Yes just once."
The doctor asked, "What was it like?"
I said, "It was dark, then suddenly very bright."
gist: An expectant father says he was present at one childbirth before, and his description of darkness then sudden light reveals it was his own birth.

characters.looks: nervous young man, expectant father
doctor in white coat, stethoscope, clipboard
pregnant woman
